audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers gave Gragas six or seven of the seven stages while the page was graded HARD, the win rate is 46.93% over 309 games, and every content why from level 3 on describes Cho'Gath winning. The tone colour was green on a HARD grade.
audit.why: Rupture's knockup zones the Body Slam engage from 3, Feast stacks outscale your chip from 4-5, and the late game is a percent-HP true-damage execute. The mirror audit already set the chart to Skill / Gragas / Cho'Gath x5.
audit.corrected: Chart flipped as one atomic group to Skill / Gragas / Cho'Gath / Cho'Gath / Cho'Gath / Cho'Gath / Cho'Gath across both layers, ratings inverted, tone set to the HARD colour and difficulty raised to 6/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike framing said 'Riftmaker is your spike — force fights' with no timing anchor, and level 6 was labelled neutral.
audit.why: Feast is 80/70/60s and every cannon stack raises his HP wall, so your first-item window is the last point where the burst still finishes him; at 6 his Rupture interrupts the dash and Feral Scream blanks the Q detonation, which is his stage, not a coin flip.
audit.corrected: phases[4] and phases[5] now sit with Cho'Gath, and the cooldown block carries Rupture 6s, Feral Scream 11s, Body Slam 14s and Explosive Cask 100s.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interactions were written generically — 'telegraphed, dodge it and burst', 'your committal tool' — with no cooldowns and no mention that Rupture is only a 6-second cooldown.
audit.why: A 6s Rupture means you cannot simply wait it out; you bait it sideways and move inside the gap. Feral Scream's 11s silence is the ability that actually kills the combo, because a silenced Gragas cannot detonate Barrel Roll early — though the cask still self-detonates after 4 seconds.
audit.corrected: tldr, winCon, trade lines and the cooldown block now name the 6s Rupture, the 11s silence and the Feast execute.

audit.why: All three flagged suspectNames — Drunken Rage, Vorpal Spikes, Feral Scream — are the real Riot names for those slots. False positives.

edits.before: Dodge his Q and silence — E-Q burst his immobile body. Gragas wins by trading around Cho'Gath's Rupture and cashing the pattern: burst his immobility and deny his farm.
edits.after: Rupture is only a 6s cooldown, so trade in the gaps: bait it sideways, then E-W-Q before Feral Scream's 11s silence blanks your detonation and he banks another Feast stack.

edits.before: Burst his immobility and deny his farm. Track Rupture before every commit and keep the wave on your side.
edits.after: Deny Feast stacks and burst him between Ruptures — his 6s knockup is the only thing stopping your Body Slam.

edits.before: Cho'Gath wins by landing Rupture, denying your pattern, and out-trading your engage windows.
edits.after: Cho'Gath wins by stacking Feast until percent-HP true damage executes you through any sustain.

edits.before: Q-poke Cho'Gath on cooldown from fog angles, W as he answers, and E-slam only when his key tool is down.
edits.after: Q-poke Cho'Gath from fog angles, W as he answers, and E-slam only in the gap after a whiffed 6s Rupture.

edits.before: Body-slamming INTO his answer — a whiffed E is 13 seconds of being a barrel with no plan.
edits.after: Body-slamming into a held Rupture — the knockup catches your dash and you feed a Feast stack.

edits.before: - Cho'Gath Rupture: matchup-defining — Telegraphed. Dodge it and burst. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Cho'Gath Rupture: 6s — telegraphed, so bait it sideways and move inside the gap. - Feral Scream: 11s silence that blanks your Q detonation. - Your Body Slam: 14s. - Explosive Cask: 100s — kill windows only.

edits.before: Overall difficulty: 4/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Rupture and how disciplined your pattern is.
edits.after: Overall difficulty: 6/10. The lane is decided by how many Feast stacks he banks before your first-item window.

edits.before: Favoured matchup — difficulty 4/10, Cho'Gath carry threat 6/10.
edits.after: Hard matchup — difficulty 6/10, Cho'Gath carry threat 6/10.

edits.before: Yours from level 1. See the level-by-level chart for the swing points.
edits.after: Yours at 2, his from 3 on. See the level-by-level chart for the swing points.

edits.before: Flash + Ignite — convert the favoured lane into kills.
edits.after: Flash + Teleport — scale, don't force an unfavoured lane.

edits.before: Your level-2 empowered-auto + Barrel Roll trade plus Happy Hour roughly match his Vorpal Spikes poke before any Feast stacks exist — genuinely even.
edits.after: Your level-2 empowered auto into a Barrel Roll sweetspot plus Happy Hour beats his Vorpal Spikes chip before any Feast stacks exist — take that trade.

notes: Mirror (chogath__gragas) recorded difficulty 5/10 on Cho'Gath's page; I set Gragas's side to 6/10 because the packet win rate is 46.93% over 309 games, which puts Cho'Gath ahead. If mirror-fix enforces strict complements it will reconcile — the packet win rate is the stronger evidence. Cho'Gath's kit file flags Rupture as 'grounding'; Riot's description says it pops enemies into the air, so no grounding claim was written. Whether the knockup can cancel a Body Slam already in flight is not in any local file — the page's existing wording keeps it as an interrupt risk, which I did not strengthen. All three flagged suspectNames are false positives.
